```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Read in data
cities <- read.csv("cities.csv")
outlook <- read.csv("outlook_meanings.csv")
forecast <- read.csv("weather_forecasts.csv")
```

```{r}
# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(cities))      
sum(is.na(outlook))     
sum(is.na(forecast))   
```

```{r}
# 2. Check for duplicate rows
sum(duplicated(cities))     
sum(duplicated(outlook))    
sum(duplicated(forecast))   
```



```{r}
# count how many times each outlook occurs
outlook_counts <- forecast %>%
  count(forecast_outlook, name = "n")   # creates columns: forecast_outlook, n

# bar chart using the counts
ggplot(outlook_counts, aes(x = forecast_outlook, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Counts of Forecast Outlooks",
    x = "Forecast outlook",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip()
```
